title: The Last Track on the Dust Collector
description: Finding an old mix CD in a garage box and hearing the exact song from the night of your driver's license test.
engagement_comment: Some songs wait patiently in the dark.
factory_topic: bittersweet happiness: Finding a dusty box of mix CDs in a garage clean-up and plugging the last one into an old car stereo, hearing the exact track that was playing the night you got your driver's license.
human_situation: Finding a dusty box of mix CDs in a garage clean-up and plugging the last one into an old car stereo, hearing the exact track that was playing the night you got your driver's license.
